Package com.pawel.sosin.model

Class ModelTest

java.lang.Object
com.pawel.sosin.model.ModelTest
public class ModelTest extends Object
This class contains unit tests for the Model class, specifically for the Rail Fence Cipher encoding and decoding functionalities.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pawel Sosin

    • setUp

      @BeforeEach public void setUp()
      Sets up a new Model instance before each test.

    • testEncodingWithSimpleInput

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({"Hello,2,Hloel","Hello World,3,HolelWrdlo","This is a private MESSAGE,5,TrShpiESiavMAssaeGitE"}) public void testEncodingWithSimpleInput(String text, int rails, String result)
      Tests the encoding function with simple valid inputs.
      Parameters:
      text - the input string to encode.
      rails - the number of rails for the Rail Fence Cipher.
      result - the expected encoded result.

    • testEncodingWithHighNumberOfRails

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({"Hello,50,Hello","Hello World,100,HelloWorld","This is a private MESSAGE,5000,ThisisaprivateMESSAGE"}) public void testEncodingWithHighNumberOfRails(String text, int rails, String result)
      Tests the encoding function when the number of rails is extremely high. The result should be the input text with spaces removed.
      Parameters:
      text - the input string to encode.
      rails - the number of rails for the Rail Fence Cipher.
      result - the expected encoded result (input text without spaces).

    • testEncodingWithTheNumberOfRailsEqualToTheTextLength

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({"Hello,5,Hello","Hello World,10,HelloWorld","This is a private MESSAGE,21,ThisisaprivateMESSAGE"}) public void testEncodingWithTheNumberOfRailsEqualToTheTextLength(String text, int rails, String result)
      Tests the encoding function when the number of rails is equal to the length of the text. The result should be the input text with spaces removed.
      Parameters:
      text - the input string to encode.
      rails - the number of rails for the Rail Fence Cipher.
      result - the expected encoded result (input text without spaces)

    • testEncodingWithIncorrectTextInput

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({"Hello.,2","Hello+ World,3","Th15 15 4 pr1vat3 M355AGe!,4","cze\u015b\u0107,2","Hello Every1,5"}) public void testEncodingWithIncorrectTextInput(String text, int rails)
      Tests the encoding function with invalid text input containing unsupported characters. Ensures that an InvalidTextException is thrown.
      Parameters:
      text - the invalid input string to encode.
      rails - the number of rails for the Rail Fence Cipher.

    • testEncodingWithIncorrectNumberOfRails

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({"Hello,0","Hello World,1","Hello,-1","Hello,-50","Hello World,0"}) public void testEncodingWithIncorrectNumberOfRails(String text, int rails)
      Tests the encoding function with invalid rail numbers (e.g., 0 or negative values). Ensures that a RailFenceCipherException is thrown.
      Parameters:
      text - the input string to encode.
      rails - the invalid number of rails (e.g., 0 or negative values)

    • testEncodingWithNoInput

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({",2",",3","\n,4","\t,15"}) public void testEncodingWithNoInput(String text, int rails)
      Tests the encoding function with empty or null input. Ensures that an InvalidTextException is thrown.
      Parameters:
      text - the null or empty input string to encode.
      rails - the number of rails for the Rail Fence Cipher.

    • testEncodingWithOnlySpaces

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({" ,2"," ,3"," ,4"," ,15"}) public void testEncodingWithOnlySpaces(String text, int rails)

    • testDecodingWithSimpleInput

      @ParameterizedTest @CsvSource({"Hloel,2,Hello","HolelWrdlo,3,HelloWorld","TrShpiESiavMAssaeGitE,5,ThisisaprivateMESSAGE"}) public void testDecodingWithSimpleInput(String text, int rails, String result)
      Tests the decoding function with simple valid inputs. Ensures that the decoded result matches the expected original text.
      Parameters:
      text - the encoded string to decode.
      rails - the number of rails for the Rail Fence Cipher.
      result - the expected decoded original text.

    • testDecodingWithHighNumberOfRails
